title: Outcome-blind preflop contextual-prior dose curve
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The 65k treatment became overdosed only after an earlier archived checkpoint that still delivers material contextual correction within the 0.05 source-preservation envelope; selecting that boundary without reward evidence can separate dose failure from direction failure.
material_change: Replay frozen source-corpus observations through parent plus matched control/treatment checkpoints at even iterations 2 through 16. Precommit selection to the latest even treatment iteration with postflop exact preservation, both overall parent TV and greedy disagreement <=0.05, and improved SB-open and BB-vs-open raise-target distance versus its same-iteration control.
baseline: Iter2 isolated smoke passed at overall TV/disagreement 0.01245/0.01043; independent iter16 pilot failed at 0.06377/0.08378. Iter16 learned panel was inconclusive and is not used for dose selection.
source: Immutable archives and session audits from v6-preflop-head-only-context-prior-65k-pilot-20260901; parent SHA256 66c2254d96e36710c1b326d17026099e6ccabdec70d8e2333cfbef26a63c4a6c; source corpus 60,671 audited states.
notes: Selection is outcome-blind and deterministic over even iterations [2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16]. No checkpoint may be selected using rollout reward, learned anchors, or Slumbot. If a boundary checkpoint exists, run exactly one new-seed 2,048-pair-per-anchor panel for that frozen matched pair.
Outcome-blind rule selected iter4. Iter6 was the first rejection because disagreement 0.06176 exceeded 0.05 despite TV 0.04876. Selected frozen SHAs control 1c0464... treatment 3969ca....

Independent review PASS: all eight dose points were recomputed from stored probability arrays with archive hashes; iter4 selection reproduced; all 6,144 selected-panel raw pairs/decks/CIs reproduced. Allocation gate failed, so no Slumbot hands.

result.summary: Outcome-blind replay selected iter4 as the last even checkpoint inside the 0.05 preservation envelope; iter6 first failed disagreement. The single untouched iter4 panel then scored -8.26 bb/100 treatment-control, CI[-27.15,10.63], with only 1/3 anchors positive.
result.conclusion: A safe contextual-prior dose exists and materially changes BB defense, but it does not improve general learned-anchor strength. Together with the overdosed iter16 result, this rejects fixed aggregate action-class priors as the next mainline; no Slumbot budget is justified.
result.next_step: Return to learned objectives rather than action-frequency targets. Use the accumulated evidence to choose a value/action-credit or genuine opponent-league/self-play learned-weight intervention that can improve per-state decisions without forcing aggregate class frequencies; retain preflop-head-only topology only as a diagnostic isolation tool.
